error: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant: nan in actual_gap_mm
actual_cause: The legacy direct-contact loop compared distance to an empty BEFORE layer-fill. GEOS returns NaN; NaN > 2nm is false, which incorrectly invents an old fill contact. R561 explicitly excludes only empty BEFORE fill with no physical old touch; any nonempty old contact and absent AFTER fill remains FAIL.
